entry.title: New: Resolution 351 (2024-2026) (Hawaiʻi County) — Adopted
entry.content:
TRANSFERS/APPROPRIATES AN APPROPRIATION OUT AND FROM A DESIGNATED FUND ACCOUNT AND CREDITS SAME TO A DESIGNATED FUND ACCOUNT TO PROVIDE A GRANT TO THE HŌLUALOA VILLAGE ‘OHANA FOR ITS 26TH ANNUAL COFFEE AND ART STROLL

Transfers $3,655 from the Clerk-Council Services – Contingency Relief account (Council District 7)
